notes.temperature: Unsupported parameter: 'temperature' is not supported with this model. Confirmed by `lf probe`; on large request bodies this arrives as a dropped connection rather than an HTTP 400.
notes.reasoning_model: Spends output tokens on hidden reasoning (seen: 401 reasoning of 561 output). max_output_tokens must stay generous or replies truncate before any content.
notes.max_output_tokens: measured by lf calibrate: output allowance is capped independently of prompt size
notes.total_tokens: Removed a guessed combined ceiling of 12,615. lf calibrate measured 20,010 input + 64,000 output accepted, which contradicts it.
